latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ai-transformation-sprint skill.

- Guides engineering teams through a 1-day AI transformation sprint to achieve 4–5x productivity.
- Includes workflow audit, AI integration design, tool selection, implementation planning, and team training.
- Provides ready-to-use templates for workflow audit, AI integration plan, training materials, and productivity metrics.
- Supports custom agent setup, multi-team rollout, and ROI calculation for advanced users.
- Designed for startups, CTOs, founders, and engineering leaders preparing teams for AI adoption.
